verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs say it integrates with Stripe (payments), Gusto (payroll), and Bill.com, among '10k+ integrations', and that real-time account data shows in the portal. A customer on HN confirms that integrations with their banks, credit cards, and Expensify handle transaction classification with no founder effort. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how connections are set up and how often they sync, a named list of supported banks, and first-party detail on how activity posts automatically to the ledger rather than through the accounting team.
